resources.string: Choose a category to find the best places in the city
This app will help you discover the best places in Izhevsk — from cozy coffee shops and restaurants with Udmurt cuisine to scenic parks, shopping centers and family-friendly attractions.

Izhevsk is the capital of the Udmurt Republic, a major industrial and cultural center of Russia. Founded in 1760 as a settlement around an iron foundry. The city is known as the birthplace of Mikhail Kalashnikov, designer of the famous AK-47. Home to over 640,000 people, the city is rich in Udmurt traditions and culture.

One of the most popular coffee shops in Izhevsk with many locations across the city. Known for affordable prices, consistent quality, and a wide range of signature drinks. A solid choice for people who want good coffee on the go.

A coffee shop with a seaside atmosphere and quality specialty coffee. Cozy wooden interior details, soft light, and relaxed music create a comfortable place to unwind. Offers a wide range of alternative brewing methods and signature drinks.

A cozy coffee shop inspired by travel and adventure. The walls feature world maps and photos of distant countries. Rich menu of signature coffee drinks, a large tea selection, and tasty pastries. A good place to meet friends.
Local coffee shop with homemade pastries

A cozy local coffee shop loved by many Izhevsk residents. Known for its homey atmosphere, house pastries, and quality coffee. Creative events and workshops are held regularly. It feels welcoming and relaxed.

A federal specialty coffee chain focused on bean quality and precision brewing. Works with single-origin beans from different parts of the world and offers filter coffee, espresso drinks, and cold alternatives. The minimalist interior keeps attention on the product.

The city's only restaurant with authentic Udmurt cuisine. Guests can try perepechi with different fillings, tabani, zyret, and other dishes prepared by past generations. The interior is designed in the style of a traditional Udmurt house with folk ornaments.
European cuisine in a historic building

A restaurant in a historic building with an elegant interior and a rich European menu. The chef updates the menu seasonally using local products. Cozy halls with live music in the evenings create a strong setting for romantic dinners.

A popular gastropub with a wide selection of craft beer and signature cuisine. Large menu of snacks, burgers, and hot dishes. Sports broadcasts, themed parties, and live concerts are held regularly. The atmosphere is warm and informal.

An Italian pizzeria with a wood-fired oven and authentic recipes. The dough is made using traditional Italian techniques with long fermentation. The menu includes classic and signature pizzas, pasta, and Italian desserts. The interior follows a Mediterranean style.

A cozy cafe with an open terrace and a scenic view of Izhevsk Pond. Offers a varied breakfast, lunch, and dinner menu. Especially popular in summer, when outdoor tables let guests enjoy meals with the sound of the water nearby. Signature fish dishes are a highlight.
Izhevsk's main park for culture and recreation

The central park of Izhevsk, founded in 1934. Located on the shore of Izhevsk Pond, it offers rides, cafes, sports grounds, and a boat station. The main alley is decorated with fountains. City holidays and festivals are often held here.
Scenic embankment of one of Europe's largest ponds

Izhevsk Pond is one of the largest artificial ponds in Europe. The landscaped embankment stretches for several kilometers and is a favorite walking area for residents. Visitors can ride bikes, rent boats, or just watch the sunset over the water.
Historic park in the city center

One of the oldest parks in Izhevsk, founded in the 19th century. Shaded alleys with old trees, cozy benches, and a small fountain create a quiet atmosphere. Concerts and open-air exhibitions are held here in summer. A good place for a calm walk downtown.
Natural forest park for quiet отдых

A picturesque forest park with century-old birches within the city limits. It has long walking and cycling trails, rest areas, and clean air. In winter there are ski tracks. A practical option for being in nature without leaving the city.
Modern square with a monument to the gunsmith

A landscaped square in the center of the city with a monument to Mikhail Timofeyevich Kalashnikov, the most famous native of Izhevsk. Well-kept lawns, modern benches, and streetlights make it suitable for walking and learning a bit of the city's history.
The largest shopping center in Izhevsk

One of the largest shopping centers in Izhevsk with more than 200 stores, restaurants, and entertainment zones. Includes a multiplex cinema, a large food court, and a children's play area. Convenient central location and large parking area.
Shopping center in the city center

A popular shopping center in the heart of Izhevsk with a broad range of clothing, footwear, electronics, and home goods stores. Includes cozy cafes, a food court, and convenient parking. Especially popular with younger visitors.

A family-oriented shopping and entertainment center with strong infrastructure for spending time together. Stores across different price ranges, a children's entertainment center, bowling, cinema, and a large food court with varied cuisine.

A shopping center focused on European and international clothing and accessory brands. Multiple floors with stores across different price segments, plus cafes and restaurants. Stylish interior and a comfortable shopping atmosphere.
Modern shopping center with anchor tenants

A modern shopping center with major anchor tenants such as a supermarket, electronics stores, and sporting goods shops. Convenient layout, wide passages, and a large food court. Sales and promotions are held regularly. Underground parking is available.
Zoo with animals from different continents

Izhevsk Zoo has a collection of more than 300 animal species from Asia, Africa, and the Americas. Spacious enclosures, regular feeding sessions with visitor participation, and a contact area with domestic animals make it suitable for a family day out.
Interactive museum about the gunsmith and the city

A modern museum and exhibition complex dedicated to the life and work of Mikhail Kalashnikov and the arms-making history of Izhevsk. Interactive exhibits, multimedia installations, and children's workshops help younger visitors engage with the city's history.
Rides for children in Kirov Park

A children's area in Kirov Park with carousels, slides, trampolines, and other attractions for different age groups. There are playgrounds for toddlers and older kids. In summer, a mini train runs through the park. Nearby cafes sell ice cream and cotton candy.

The Izhevsk Planetarium is one of the favorite places for schoolchildren and their parents. Shows about the night sky, planets, and space missions are the main draw. Astronomy programs are adapted for different ages, and telescopes are used for night observations.
Puppet theater with Udmurt fairy tales

The state puppet theater Tol Babai is one of the strongest children's theaters in the republic. Its repertoire includes classic fairy tales and productions based on Udmurt folklore. Bright scenery, live music, and strong acting make performances memorable.
